Independently reproduced ALL 17 nonzero periodic and 13 nonzero extinction coefficients, and P(1,1,2)=9, E(1,1,2)=240, (P(2,2,2)-1)/4=138, E(2,2,2)=2632. Finite support enumeration is an exhaustive all-size certificate only because the reduction is proved; the 27^n rare-event term follows analytically from the top e333=4 coefficient and smaller remaining exponential bases.

originality.rationale: PASS: The count of four-cycles itself matches a previously reported cyclic-contact tripartite polynomial and is not original. The surviving separate claim is equality of the actual labelled recurrent configurations and phase maps for distinct update rules, together with the Greenberg-Hastings extinction-basin polynomial, sharp six-step cutoff, and asymptotic. The 1995 primary full article concerns one-dimensional infinite-lattice excitation, not labelled tripartite basins. Three-color arbitrary-graph work and binary parity multiparts do not imply the four-state result. Residual priority risk: the cited earlier same-family finding was available via the reviewed source description rather than full independent archival comparison.
